subject: Request: PO template, payor mapping & bank evidence for CloudNova listing
messages:
From: Sofie Lund <sofie.lund@cloud-nova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloud-nova.com
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO template and onboarding evidence for CloudNova listing

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for walking us through the listing checklist on yesterday's call. To keep the procurement team moving, could you please: 

- Share Redwood's standard PO template (we need the exact billing name and remit-to fields)
- Send the vendor onboarding evidence checklist you require for marketplace activation (SOC2 attestation / invoice samples / bank info format)
- Confirm whether Redwood accepts reseller invoices from EU entities (we're listing as a reseller in EU and need to confirm VAT handling)

I'll attach our bank info file for your finance team to validate formatting. If there's any additional legal or tax paperwork we should prepare, let me know. We are hoping to complete paperwork this week so we can go-live with the listing next month.

Attachments: CloudNova_Bank_Info.pdf (bank account + SWIFT, PDF)

Thanks,
Sofie Lund
Head of Partnerships | CloudNova
sofie.lund@cloud-nova.com
+44 20 7946 0810

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Lund <sofie.lund@cloud-nova.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PO template and onboarding evidence for CloudNova listing

Hi Sofie —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Attached are the two docs your procurement team will need: our PO template and the vendor evidence checklist. High-level notes below so your finance/legal teams know what to expect: 

1) PO template (redwood_po_template.docx) — please ensure the billing name matches the legal entity in your invoice. Our AP team requires: billing name, billing address, remit-to (bank wiring instructions), and a Redwood purchase order number (we'll provide the PO once contract is countersigned).

2) Evidence checklist (redwood_evidence_checklist.csv) — we request: 
   - SOC 2 Type II report or attestation statement (if available)
   - Sample pro-forma invoice that includes VAT breakdown (EU sellers)
   - Bank account details in IBAN/SWIFT format (your attached PDF looks fine, finance will confirm)
   - W-8/W-9 or local entity tax form (for non-US/US entities respectively)

3) Payor mapping: For CloudNova as an EU reseller, we usually need to decide whether Redwood will invoice CloudNova (reseller) or the end customer through marketplace routing. If you want Redwood to invoice CloudNova, please confirm the legal entity name and VAT number where invoices should be addressed — that will determine whether VAT is reverse-charged or included.

4) Timing: once we receive the completed checklist + tax forms and an approved PO request from your side, ops typically clears the vendor in 3–5 business days. If you need expedited handling we can flag it but will require a purchase order and the completed checklist.

I've looped in Vanessa who manages marketplace billing exceptions and Lauren who owns vendor enablement so they can review CloudNova's bank file and confirm payor mapping options.

Attachments: redwood_po_template.docx; redwood_evidence_checklist.csv

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Sofie Lund <sofie.lund@cloud-nova.com>

Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 08:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: PO template and onboarding evidence for CloudNova listing

Thanks Jordan — attaching the bank PDF again (per your suggestion in case finance wants a new file). A couple quick clarifications from our procurement lead: 

- We prefer Redwood to invoice CloudNova (reseller) rather than the end customer. Our legal entity is CloudNova Ltd, VAT GB345678901. Please confirm whether that will be fine for Redwood's EU invoicing (reverse-charge vs. VAT included).
- Our AP team asked whether Redwood requires invoices to show the marketplace pass-through ID. Is that something your billing needs?

Minor: I noticed the PO template has a blank "Remit-To" line; I assume Redwood's bank details are internal and you will provide final remit instructions on the PO.

We aim to return the completed checklist + VAT docs by Monday. Appreciate the quick review.

Attachments: CloudNova_Bank_Info.pdf

Best,
Sofie

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CloudNova payor mapping request and PO exception?

Lauren / Vanessa —

Quick internal note after Sofie's reply: CloudNova wants Redwood to invoice the reseller entity (CloudNova Ltd, VAT GB345678901). They also asked whether we can include a marketplace pass-through ID on invoices. 

Ask: can we accept CloudNova as payor for marketplace listings without passing VAT to end customers (i.e., invoice reseller and let them handle VAT)? If that is allowed, we need to: 
- Confirm VAT handling (reverse charge or VAT included) with finance/legal
- Approve a PO exception to allow reseller payor mapping for this marketplace listing (their legal has a reseller clause)
- Confirm final remit-to instructions to include on the PO before providing it to CloudNova

Related: HubSpot CLDN-4821 has their commercial record and contract draft (link below). If you agree, I propose we approve an exception and issue a PO once we have their completed checklist + VAT docs (they expect to return by Monday).

Link: https://hub.redwood.com/deals/CLDN-4821

If either of you wants to take point on the exception approval, LMK — otherwise I'll raise a quick approval ticket with finance.

Thanks,
Jordan
